item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently transfers title and improvements to the Territory of Hawaii; the legal consequence occurs through this provision itself.","evidence":"title to the following-described tract of land at Sand Island"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself encumbers the transfer with reserved federal easements and imposes a relocation duty on the Territory, with termination tied to future abandonment.","evidence":"A reservation of easements and improvements appurtenant thereto, in favor of the United States of America"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently reserves portions of the transferred land to the United States until relocation is completed.","evidence":"there are hereby reserved to the United States all such portions of the land hereinabove described"},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself subjects the transferred land to present and future airport-zoning laws, rules, and regulations.","evidence":"shall be subject to all the laws, rules and regulations with respect to airport zoning"},{"segment_id":"5","code":3,"rationale":"The provision directly imposes on the Territory a legal duty to provide necessary access rights and utility easements to serve retained federal land.","evidence":"The Territory of Hawaii shall provide such rights of access and utility easements"},{"segment_id":"6","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself legally conditions any sale, lease, or other disposition of the transferred lands on the cited statute.","evidence":"shall be subject to the provisions of the act of August 25, 1958"},{"segment_id":"7","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself makes the transferred land subject to the statute's other provisions.","evidence":"The land transferred by this order shall be subject to such other provisions"},{"segment_id":"8","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently withdraws the transferred lands from prior executive-order reservations and federal jurisdiction and control.","evidence":"are hereby withdrawn from the application of any such orders or from such jurisdiction and control"}]}
